text:
Avery M.: morning folks, excited to start! stuck on SSO for a few apps. Okta lists Google Workspace and 1Password but when I click 1Password I get 'SAMLResponse missing' and it loops back to Okta. Drive opens but Docs says 'access denied'. tried clearing cookies, incognito. any quick triage? :wave:
Zoe (IT): welcome! :wave: Can you paste your work email and the exact Okta error? Also are you behind a corporate VPN? sometimes SAML assertions get blocked by WAFs or proxies.
Avery M.: email avery.m@redwood.com. error text: "SAMLResponse missing or invalid". not on VPN, home wifi. screenshot: https://pasteboard.mock/saml.png
Provision Bot: Provisioning status for avery.m@redwood.com: SCIM: completed; Groups: pending; MFA: unenrolled
Zoe (IT): hm SCIM done but groups pending explains Docs access. I'll force-sync your groups. Marco from infra — can you check 1Password SAML provider logs for a failed assertion?
Marco: checking 1Password logs now. seeing a mismatch in relayState, looks like Okta is sending an old relayState from a previous template. Re-applying SAML config to 1Password tenant.
Avery M.: thanks. any way I can get temporary access to docs? need the onboarding doc ASAP.
Jenna S.: @Zoe I can share the onboarding doc DM to avery.m for now. also, if they need GitHub repo access, tag me.
Marco: re-applied SAML settings. Try SSO again and if it loops, please paste the full redirect URL (no need to include tokens) — we need the relayState param.
Avery M.: tried, still loop. here's redirect URL: https://okta.redwood.com/sso/saml?RelayState=old-template&SAMLRequest=... (truncated)
Zoe (IT): Ok — that's the old RelayState. I'm unassigning the stale 1Password app instance and assigning the updated one. Should be instant. Also enabling backup SMS for MFA in your profile.
Provision Bot: Ticket #ONB-317 created by Zoe (IT): 1Password SSO relayState mismatch for avery.m@redwood.com
Avery M.: got an SMS with code, enrolled MFA, retried SSO. 1Password now signs in, Docs access still pending.
Marco: Docs access is group-based; groups just finished syncing — you should have access in <2 minutes.
Avery M.: verified Docs access, can open onboarding doc. thanks team! :tada:
Zoe (IT): great! we will close the ticket after 24h if no regressions. ping us in #new-hires if anything else blocks you. :lock:
Avery M.: will do. appreciate the quick help!
